name: SillyTavern
summary: Local-first LLM roleplay frontend for power users: total control over prompts, samplers, V2 character cards and lorebooks, plus any backend (local vLLM/Kobold/Oobabooga or OpenRouter/DeepSeek). Zero platform censorship because there is no platform server.
ranking_rationale: Strong sustained community backing across power-user forums and developer threads for total backend freedom, extensibility, and zero platform censorship. Steep setup curve and pay-as-you-go API costs are the main tradeoffs; ranked #1 for NSFW freedom, testability, and privacy.

pricing.free_tier: 100% free software (self-hosted or bring your own API key)
pricing.notes: SillyTavern has no hosted subscription. Running local models costs nothing beyond your hardware; external API providers (OpenRouter, DeepSeek, etc.) bill separately.

pros: Completely free, open-source frontend with no platform subscription
Zero platform censorship because everything runs locally
Connects to local models (vLLM, Kobold, Ollama) or any external API
Deep control over prompts, samplers, V2 character cards, and lorebooks
cons: Steep initial setup and configuration curve compared to hosted apps
Mobile use requires LAN hosting or Termux workarounds
Heavy agentic or long-context API use can get expensive quickly

facts.value: Heavy - power-user subreddit and Hacker News threads 2025-2026; a cited user spent $150+ in a month on agentic tool-use tokens
facts.notes: Community evidence with dated quotes, on file.
